name: Subtle Performance
body:
Benefit(s): When you use a performance that is an enchantment, creatures that succeed on the saving throw have only a 50% chance to realize they succeeded on the saving throw (instead of it being automatic). If the creature fails the saving throw, or is affected by such a performance with no saving throw, the creature does not realize they are under the effects of the performance (even after the performance ends), and the Sense Motive DC to notice the creature is under the effects of an enchantment increases by 5.

Normal: Anyone who successfully saves against one of your enchantment performances notices the mental intrusion automatically, and automatically realizes the mental intrusion after the effect ends.
